description: List hotels, optionally filtered by city and/or star rating. Sorted by stars desc then price asc.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of hotel objects.

description: Retrieve a full hotel object by hid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full hotel object.

description: Register a new hotel property in the catalog.

city.description: City the hotel is located in.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new hotel object.

description: List reservations, optionally filtered by status and/or hotel_id. Sorted by check_in.

status.description: Optional status filter (booked, checked_in, checked_out, cancelled).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of reservation summaries.

description: Retrieve a full reservation object by resid.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the full reservation object.

description: Book a room at a hotel between check_in and check_out (ISO dates). Total price is nights * hotel rate.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new reservation summary.

description: Cancel a reservation that has not yet been checked out or cancelled.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the cancelled reservation summary.

description: Check in to a booked reservation. Moves status from 'booked' to 'checked_in'.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated reservation summary.

description: Check out of a checked-in reservation. Moves status from 'checked_in' to 'checked_out'.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the updated reservation summary.

description: List reviews, optionally filtered by hotel_id. Sorted by date descending.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of review objects.

description: Attach a rated review (1..5) with a text comment to a hotel.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is the new review object.

description: Compute average rating and review count for a hotel.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {hid, count, average}.

description: Search for hotels in a city that have no conflicting reservation between check_in and check_out.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of available hotel results with total_price.

description: List a guest's upcoming reservations (booked or checked_in with check_in >= today).

today.description: Optional ISO date anchor (defaults to session time).

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is a list of reservation summaries.

description: Return the amenities list for a hotel.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {hid, amenities}.

description: Aggregate stats: hotel count, reservations by status, review count, and booked/completed revenue.

returns.description: A dictionary with status and output. On success, output is {hotels, reservations, by_status, reviews, booked_revenue}.
